# Shared behavior contract for the symlink resolver, driven against BOTH
# implementations by test/spec/resolve-link.spec.js:
#   bin/resolve-link.js  (used by bin/install_bashrc.js  -- UNV-9)
#   bin/resolve-link.sh  (used by bin/nvx                -- UNV-10)
#
# Adding a case here tests both. If the two ever need to diverge, that is a bug
# in one of them, not a reason to split this file.
#
# Format:  name | setup | input | expected
#   setup   ";"-separated ops, or "-" for none:
#             dir:<path>            mkdir -p
#             file:<path>           write a regular file
#             link:<path>-><target> symlink, target used verbatim (relative stays relative)
#   input   path handed to the resolver, relative to the case's temp dir
#   expected  $T = the temp dir (already canonicalized), or the literal ELOOP

# A plain file resolves to itself.
regular file|file:profile|profile|$T/profile

# A path that does not exist is not a link; it resolves to itself so the caller
# can create it. (This is the case existsSync+realpathSync got right by accident
# and the one below got wrong.)
missing file|-|profile|$T/profile

# The ordinary dotfile-manager layout: .bashrc -> ~/.dotfiles/bashrc
symlink to existing file|file:real;link:profile->real|profile|$T/real

# UNV-9 / UNV-10 core case: the link's target does not exist yet. existsSync
# follows the link and reports false, so realpath was skipped and rename(2)
# clobbered the link itself.
dangling symlink|link:profile->missing|profile|$T/missing

# Chains must be followed to the end, not just one hop.
symlink chain|file:c;link:b->c;link:profile->b|profile|$T/c
symlink chain with dangling tail|link:b->missing;link:profile->b|profile|$T/missing

# A relative link resolves against the directory holding the link, not cwd.
relative link in subdir|dir:sub;file:real;link:sub/profile->../real|sub/profile|$T/real
relative link same dir|file:real;link:profile->./real|profile|$T/real

# A symlinked parent directory is canonicalized (the temp file for the atomic
# rename has to land in the real directory -- rename cannot cross filesystems).
symlinked parent dir|dir:realdir;file:realdir/profile;link:linkdir->realdir|linkdir/profile|$T/realdir/profile

# A cycle must be reported, not spun on.
symlink loop|link:a->b;link:b->a|a|ELOOP
